description.value: Coast Fraser Inn is a full-service chain hotel in Williams Lake operated by Coast Hotels, offering comfortable rooms with mountain views and a free hot breakfast each morning. An on-site Boston Pizza provides a reliable evening meal option after a long day in the saddle, and the hotel is conveniently located about 10 minutes from Williams Lake Regional Airport. It is a solid base for exploring the Cariboo region, with a hot tub and fitness centre available for recovery.
